 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 participant P as Parent: host root
 participant C as Child: namespaces
 participant S as Workload shell
 P->>P: Unshare mount namespace and make mounts private
 P->>P: Chown upper and mount OverlayFS
 P->>P: Bind merged and ParentMountAll
 P->>P: Apply bind, named-volume, and tmpfs mounts
 P->>C: Start child with merged path and ID mappings
 Note over C: Wait on the inherited pipe
 P->>P: Add child to cgroup
 P->>C: Release the child
 C->>C: Set hostname and mount proc and PivotRoot
 C->>S: Run inspection or supplied command
 S-->>C: Workload exits
 C-->>P: Child exits and Wait returns
 P->>P: Clean cgroup and unmount data attachments in reverse order
 P->>P: Detach staged rootfs bind and unmount overlay
 Note over P: Named-volume data and upper files remain on disk",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
